blocks.text: Beauty queen and lawyer Eva Patalinjug has welcomed the delegates of the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant to Cebu, and reminded them of the value of culture and connection in their quest for the crown. The former Binibining Pilipinas and Mutya ng Pilipinas titleholder, the president of the 58-year-old international pageant organization, addressed the delegates and guests at the Sashing Ceremony held in Cebu City on Sept. 25. There, the 38 delegates from around the world received their official sashes bearing the names of their respective countries and territories.
